login.logo_sub: Your farms, devices, and live intelligence
login.subtitle: Sign in with the same account you use on AgriSetu.

tour.field_body: Choose the field paired with your ESP8266 device. Use + Field to add a new one with your Device ID from the Arduino sketch.
tour.connection_body: This banner shows whether your Arduino sensors are online. Predictions and live advisories need an active connection.
tour.sensors_body: Soil moisture, temperature, and water level update every few seconds from your field hardware.
tour.alerts_body: Irrigation, drought, heat, and flood alerts appear here. Tap the speaker icon on any alert to hear it read aloud.
tour.irrigation_body: Get a clear irrigate-now or wait recommendation with urgency, next check time, and suggested water volume.
tour.risk_body: Track drought, flood, heat, and disease-climate yield risk scores. Use Refresh Advice to update.
tour.vision_body: Upload a leaf photo or run a demo to detect disease, pest damage, and nutrient issues on-device.
tour.predict_body: When sensors are online, predict the best crop from live conditions. Speaker icons read results aloud.
tour.analytics_body: Review moisture and yield-risk trends over time to spot patterns in your field performance.

irrigation.rainfall_sufficient: Irrigate later — recent/expected rainfall is sufficient.
irrigation.severe_stress: Irrigate now — severe water stress detected.
irrigation.below_comfort: Irrigate soon — soil moisture below crop comfort zone.
irrigation.well_hydrated: Delay irrigation — soil is already well hydrated.
irrigation.adequate: Moisture is adequate — maintain scheduled light irrigation.
irrigation.reservoir_low: Reservoir critically low — top up water source first.
irrigation.irrigate_now: Irrigate now — severe water stress detected.
irrigation.delay_irrigation: Irrigate later — recent/expected rainfall is sufficient.
irrigation.monitor: Moisture is adequate — maintain scheduled light irrigation.

drought.label: Drought / Water Stress
drought.advice: Mulch soil, irrigate in early morning, reduce plant density if prolonged.

flood.label: Flood / Excess Rainfall
flood.advice: Improve drainage channels; avoid fertilizer until soil drains.

heat.label: Heat Stress
heat.advice: Provide shade nets, irrigate lightly at dusk, avoid midday spraying.

disease_climate.label: Disease Outbreak Climate
disease_climate.advice: Scout leaves daily; improve airflow; prepare preventive fungicide if needed.

status.unknown: Soil pH sensor not available — consider manual soil test (NPK kit).

action.apply_lime: Apply agricultural lime (2–4 kg / 100 m²) after soil test.
action.avoid_ammonium: Avoid excess ammonium fertilizers until pH rises.
action.use_compost: Use organic compost and acidifying fertilizers (e.g. ammonium sulphate).
action.foliar_spray: Foliar Fe/Zn spray if yellowing between leaf veins appears.
action.monitor_tip_burn: Monitor for tip burn; light lime if crop is sensitive.
action.add_compost_chlorosis: Add compost; watch for interveinal chlorosis.
action.ph_optimal: pH in good range — balance NPK based on crop stage.
action.collect_sample: Collect soil sample for NPK and pH lab / kit test.
action.correct_moisture: Correct moisture before fertilizing — dry soil wastes nutrients.
